## Setup React App Locally in Seconds

Ready-to-use shell script that will set up and run a React app locally in seconds — assuming Node.js is already installed.

This script will:
	1.	Create a new React app (with TypeScript if you want)
	2.	Install dependencies
	3.	Start the development server

✅ Script: run-react-app.sh

```bash
#!/bin/bash

# 🚀 Prompt for project name
read -p "Enter your React project name (default: my-react-app): " APP_NAME

# 📦 Use default if empty
APP_NAME=${APP_NAME:-my-react-app}

# ❓ Prompt for TypeScript
read -p "Do you want TypeScript? (y/n): " use_ts

# 🛠 Create the app
if [ "$use_ts" == "y" ]; then
  npx create-react-app "$APP_NAME" --template typescript
else
  npx create-react-app "$APP_NAME"
fi

cd "$APP_NAME"
npm start
```


📌 **How to Use**:

	1.	Save the script as run-react-app.sh
	2.	Make it executable:

```bash
chmod +x run-react-app.sh
```
    3.	Run it:

```bash
./run-react-app.sh
```


 🧠 **What You Need Pre-installed**

- **Node.js** (v18 or higher recommended)
- **npm** (comes with Node.js)
- **npx** (comes with Node.js)
